newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan paper retracts Acer Olivetti report.
newsitem.headline: Milan paper retracts Acer Olivetti report.

text.p: The editor of an Italian financial newspaper said a report it carried in Friday's edition about an approach by Taiwanese computer group Acer to buy the personal computer division of Olivetti was partly incorrect.

Pierluigi Magnaschi, editor of business daily MF, told Reuters that the newspaper had incorrectly quoted Olivetti managing director Roberto Colaninno as saying that talks were under way to sell the PC unit to Acer.
But he stood by a separate report in the paper, which quoted the head of Acer's Italian operations Aldo Grech as saying: "Acer has had and is continuing to have contacts with Olivetti."
Grech did not specify the nature of the talks.
No-one at Acer could immediately be reached for comment.
Shares in the troubled information technology group slid 3.44 percent to 461 lire at midsession in a broadly firmer Milan market and were the busiest stock with 19.6 million shares traded.
